description: A small web component, <fun-loader>, that shows rotating loading messages with an animated icon while an AI/LLM request or other slow task runs. Includes 8 themes, 5 icons, custom messages, and React and Vue wrappers. Messages change as the wait grows. About 4 kB, no dependencies. Published on npm as @vectorchi/fun-loader.
rules: Import '@vectorchi/fun-loader' once to register <fun-loader> and all built-in themes. In React use FunLoader from '@vectorchi/fun-loader/react'; in Vue use FunLoader from '@vectorchi/fun-loader/vue'.
In React, use the FunLoader wrapper rather than the raw <fun-loader> tag: on React 18 the raw tag cannot receive a messages array or paused={false}.
In Next.js the React wrapper is already a client component, so it can be rendered from a server component without adding 'use client'.
messages (string[]) is a property or prop only; there is no messages attribute. It overrides theme; set it to null to return to the theme.

Boolean attributes (paused, ordered) are on whenever present, even paused="false". Turn them off with the property (el.paused = false) or the framework prop. Messages are shuffled by default; add ordered to keep the written order.
Render the loader only while waiting and remove it when the result arrives; removing it stops its timer. For streamed responses, remove it when the first chunk arrives.
For payment or money-transfer flows use theme="transfer", and don't write custom messages that claim backend steps that aren't actually happening.
Set label to describe the wait for screen readers (default "Loading"); the rotating text itself is hidden from them.

Every built-in theme changes its messages after 8 s and 20 s of waiting. To use your own timings, set the stages property or prop ({ after: ms, messages }[]); set stages to null to keep the first set of messages for the whole wait.
